focus_areas: Texture realism of the central yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness and separation between petals and background
Natural variation in petal shape and spacing (avoiding perfect symmetry)
Lighting consistency across the curved surface of the disc
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'granular' texture of the yellow center. AI often smears this into a solid yellow mass or creates repetitive, tiled patterns. Verify that the transition between the yellow disc and white petals is sharp and biologically plausible, without haloing or color bleeding. Check for any unnatural symmetry in the petal arrangement.
image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a single daisy flower. The image features a prominent central yellow disc composed of tightly packed florets, surrounded by white ray petals radiating outward. Green sepals or leaves are visible peeking through the gaps between the petals near the center.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the specific botanical classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on fine-grained features.
To ensure clean separation between the yellow disc and white petals, checking for color bleeding or fusion artifacts common in generative models.
To analyze the micro-texture of the disc florets and petal edges for signs of AI smoothing, melting, or repetitive patterns.
